posts.title: When The Queen Is Missing
posts.description: On the Billboard Pop Shop Podcast , Katie Atkinson and Keith Caulfield take a closer look at the “big four” Grammy categories at the upcoming 2027 Grammy Awards , along with the pop/dance categories, where RAYE, Rosalía, Madonna, Tinashe and Ariana Grande lead the way. Keith also shares his thoughts about Madonna scoring several pop/dance nominations but missing the one for album of the year . and not being nominated with her Confessions II – The Film either. Listen to the podcast below or on your favourite platform. The Billboard Pop Shop Podcast is a one-stop shop for all things pop on Billboard‘s weekly charts, with a lively discussion about the latest pop news, fun chart stats and stories, new music, and guest interviews with music stars and folks from the world of pop. Casual pop fans and chart junkies can hear Billboard‘s executive digital director, West Coast, Katie Atkinson and Billboard’s managing director, charts and data operations, Keith Caulfield every week on the podcast,

posts.title: Five Nominations for Madonna at the 2027 Grammys
posts.description: Grammy nominations day is here! The 69th Grammy Awards Nominations are announced today starting at 4:45 a.m. PT/7:45 a.m. ET. While they announce the nominees across all 100 Grammy Categories in real time, check out the ones Madonna scored this year – so far. Now that all the nominations have been announced, and once again Madonna is missing from all the main categories where the American music industry competes – she’s not even nominated for Record, Album, Song or Video of the Year – it becomes clear that the Queen of Pop is still considered a dance act who had the lucky chance to score a Billboard no.1 album at 68. And it only took 16 years to nominate her again. posts.title: Meet Me In The Dance Tent
posts.description: The confirmed line up for the 2027 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival dropped yesterday with the official poster shared on Instagram , carrying five very specific words: Madonna In The Dance Tent . Madonna’s longtime manager, Guy Oseary , shared the news virtually at the same time, using capital letters to stress out what’s this really about: @madonna IN THE DANCE TENT 21 years later… time goes by.. so slowly.. @coachella Her fan understood. Madonna ‘s return to the Dance Tent at Coachella 21 years after Confessions On A Dance Floor does not only mean coming full-circle: it is a door open to the future. And the Madonna fans know what it means – so you will forgive us if we spare you some of the patronizing comments that flooded the internet yesterday, all meticolously explaining why Madonna is not headlining and why she’s playing the tent : again, we know , no matter if we were in the desert, or we saw Madonna making history from afar, and how old we were on April 30, 2006.
